svg.title: MealMind — architecture: Real-time sync
svg.desc: MealMind architecture — Real-time sync. The customer app (orders) pays through Razorpay (payments). Razorpay calls a webhook handled by Cloud Functions on Firebase, which makes one write to Firestore — the single source of truth, with security rules scoped per role. Firestore syncs that write live to the customer app, the chef app (kitchen screen) and the admin app (dashboard). All three are Flutter apps, and a confirmed payment reaches the chef screen and admin dashboard in under a second.
